title: Dashed-ring quad geometry duplicated verbatim from draw_ring_annulus instead of parameterizing it
evidence: assist.odin 504-519: table := SPAWN_RING_TABLE // local copy — a constant can't be indexed by a runtime index ... j := (i + 1) % SPAWN_RING_SEGS ... rl.DrawTriangle(p1o, p1i, p2o, col) rl.DrawTriangle(p2o, p1i, p2i, col); spawn_fx.odin 384-402: draw_ring_annulus :: proc(v: ^View, c: rl.Vector2, r_in, r_out: f32, col: rl.Color) { ... for i in 0 ..< SPAWN_RING_SEGS { j := (i + 1) % SPAWN_RING_SEGS ... rl.DrawTriangle(p1o, p1i, p2o, col) rl.DrawTriangle(p2o, p1i, p2i, col) } }
detail: The segment-quad construction (table lookup, j wrap, CCW winding, two triangles) is copy-pasted from draw_ring_annulus with only a dash predicate added; future winding/geometry fixes must now land in two places.
recommended_fix: Extend draw_ring_annulus with an optional segment predicate (or a draw_ring_annulus_segments proc) and have draw_tie_mark call it with tie_dash_on.
